title: A closed point gives a closed residue-field immersion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $x\in X$, with residue field $\kappa(x)$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Let $i_x:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)\to X$ be the canonical morphism induced by the residue homomorphism $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\kappa(x)$. Then $\{x\}$ is closed in $X$ if and only if $i_x$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
